messages:
Keisha: Heads-up folks, the cold brew carafe is empty and the sugar jar is crusty. Also the milk carton in the back is unlabeled. :thinking:
Marco: Oof. I can swing by and restock cold brew + oat milk (2) at 3pm. Anyone want anything else?
Omar: If you're out, could you grab a small pack of almond biscotti and some stirrers? Also, reminder: please don't microwave takeaway clamshells. We had a melt incident yesterday. :sweat_smile:
Bea: Adding: stirrers + biscotti. Also I'll leave a sticky note on the unlabeled milk saying "do not drink if not yours" until we label it.
Keisha: Can someone also check the tea box? We're down to peppermint. I prefer green but will survive.
Marco: Got it. Cold brew, oat milk x2, biscotti, stirrers, extra green tea. ETA 15:10. Cash or Venmo for items?
Omar: Venmo works. I'll Venmo you $6 for biscotti + my coffee share.
SnackBot: note: supply_low -> cold_brew=0, oat_milk=1, stirrers=3. Restock scheduled by user Marco at 2026-04-05T15:10Z.
Bea: Quick ask: can we put a tiny "what's gone" checkbox on the cabinet? People can tick when they take the last of something. Saves mystery shopping.
Keisha: Love that. I'll make a printable checklist and stick it on the shelf tonight.
Marco: Perfect. I'll leave the receipt on the snack box and write "cabinet checklist implemented" in the note.
Omar: Also, FYI: someone left a half-eaten kimchi container at 18:30 last week. Please label fermenting items as 'odor risk' ;)
